outcomes.outcome: the profile file is root-only and NetworkManager loads it as an OpenVPN connection under its name
the loaded profile carries the parameters (remote, CA, VPN user, cipher, password auth, tap)
only the local user may use the connection, and its UUID is stable (fqdn_uuid of the name)
connecting through the profile to an OpenVPN server

uncovered.why: the profile stores the password as agent-owned (password-flags=1), so a connection needs a desktop session's secret agent, and the class's node is gnome while the runner starts only Plasma sessions; it also needs an OpenVPN server with the matching tap/password setup on a peer
uncovered.lifted_by: capability: a GNOME desktop session in phase3 runs, with an OpenVPN server peer
uncovered.evidence: phase3.py session_problems accepts only desktop plasma; nodes.yml: the class's node gnome (capabilities [desktop, gnome]); status.py --standins: openvpn_nm_connection
